item.title: How to configure Python virtual environment and Docker
item.description: Python is a popular, high-level, general-purpose programming language known for its simplicity and readability. A virtual environment is an isolated Python environment that allows you to work on a project without affecting the global Python installation or other projects. It ensures that dependencies for one project do not interfere with others. Dependencies are external libraries or packages that a Python project requires to function. Task: Suppose you have several ML projects, each project requires a seperate python environment with different python version.
